# PlayDreamz

> PlayDreamz is an independent editorial site for the ACGC community — Anime, Card Games (TCG), Collectibles, and Games — with honest guides and market insights.

## Games

- [Games hub](https://playdreamz.com/games/): Video game guides organized by game.
- [Dave the Diver](https://playdreamz.com/games/dave-the-diver/): All Dave the Diver guides.
- [Best Weapons in Dave the Diver: Every Gun Upgrade, Harpoon & Melee Pick](https://playdreamz.com/dave-the-diver-best-weapons/): The best weapons in Dave the Diver for bosses, crowds and high-grade fish, every gun upgrade tree from the Death Rifle to the Penta Axel, Harpoon Gun upgrade costs and the melee weapons worth grabbing.
- [Every Dave the Diver Boss: How to Beat Each Story, Optional & DLC Boss](https://playdreamz.com/dave-the-diver-bosses-guide/): Every Dave the Diver boss in story order, from the Giant Squid to Yawie: how to beat each one, how to unlock the optional bosses like Klaus and Lusca, DLC bosses and what every boss drops.
- [Dave the Diver Money Guide: How to Make More Gold After the Early Game](https://playdreamz.com/dave-the-diver-money-guide/): Make more gold in Dave the Diver after the early game: top dishes, the Fish Farm and rice paddy, staff worth training, the branch, VIP guests and party nights.
- [Dave the Diver DLC Guide: Every Content Pack, Price & How to Start](https://playdreamz.com/dave-the-diver-dlc-guide/): Every Dave the Diver DLC explained: In the Jungle, Ichiban’s Holiday, Godzilla, DREDGE, Guilty Gear Strive and Subnautica 2, with prices and how to start the ones already released.
- [Dave the Diver Beginner's Guide: Story, Gameplay & Tips](https://playdreamz.com/dave-the-diver-beginners-guide/): New to Dave the Diver? Learn the story, how diving and the sushi bar work, what to upgrade first, staff and Cooksta tips, and 12 beginner tips for 2026.
- [Palworld](https://playdreamz.com/games/palworld/): All Palworld guides.
- [Best Passive Skills in Palworld 1.0: Combat, Work & Mount Tier List](https://playdreamz.com/palworld-best-passive-skills/): The best Palworld 1.0 passive skills for combat, base work and mounts, the passives to avoid, Surgery Table costs, where to get every Implant and recommended builds.
- [Palworld Breeding Guide (1.0): Best Combos, Cakes & How It Works](https://playdreamz.com/palworld-breeding-guide/): How breeding works in Palworld 1.0: the Breeding Farm, every cake and what it does, how the child is decided, the easiest combos for Anubis, Jormuntide and more, and how passives are inherited.
- [Best Mounts in Palworld 1.0: Fastest Flying, Ground & Water Pals](https://playdreamz.com/palworld-best-mounts/): The fastest mounts in Palworld 1.0: flying, ground and water Pals ranked by sprint speed, with saddle Technology levels, where to catch each one and the best early-game picks.
- [Best Pals for Every Job in Palworld 1.0: Mining, Handiwork, Kindling & More](https://playdreamz.com/palworld-best-pals-for-work/): The best Palworld 1.0 Pals for every work suitability, from Kindling and Mining to Handiwork and Transporting: early, mid-game and endgame picks, levels and where to catch them.
- [Palworld 1.0 Tower Bosses Guide: Weaknesses, Order & How to Win](https://playdreamz.com/palworld-tower-bosses-guide/): Every Palworld 1.0 tower boss, from Zoe & Grizzbolt to Auri & Shaolong: elements, weaknesses, HP, key attacks, the best Pals to bring and Hard Mode rewards.
- [Palworld 1.0 Beginner’s Guide: First Base, Best Early Pals & Catching Tips](https://playdreamz.com/palworld-beginners-guide/): New to Palworld 1.0? Start here: your first hour, building a base, the best early Pals, how catching works, the tower boss order and 10 beginner tips.

## Trading Card Games

- [TCG hub](https://playdreamz.com/tcg/): Trading card game guides and market insights.
- [Pokémon TCG](https://playdreamz.com/tcg/pokemon/): All Pokémon card guides.
- [One Piece Card Game](https://playdreamz.com/tcg/one-piece/): All One Piece card guides.
- [Best One Piece Cards in Every Set: The Big Hits From OP-01 to OP-17](https://playdreamz.com/best-one-piece-cards-by-set/): The big hits in every English One Piece Card Game set, from OP-01 Romance Dawn to OP-17: the Manga Rares, SP cards and Treasure Rares collectors chase, with pictures of every card.
- [One Piece TCG Sets in Order: Every English Booster From OP-01 to OP-18](https://playdreamz.com/one-piece-tcg-sets-in-order/): Every English One Piece Card Game booster in release order, from OP-01 Romance Dawn to OP-18, with Extra and Premium Boosters, release dates, pack prices, chase cards and block numbers.
- [One Piece Card Rarity Guide: Every Rarity From Common to Manga Rare](https://playdreamz.com/one-piece-card-rarity-guide/): Every One Piece card rarity explained, from C and UC to SEC, plus Alt-Arts, Manga Rares, SP cards and Treasure Rares, how to read a card, what each rarity is worth and English vs Japanese.
- [Cyberpunk TCG](https://playdreamz.com/tcg/cyberpunk/): All Cyberpunk TCG guides.
- [Cyberpunk TCG Rarity Symbols: Every Rarity in Welcome to Night City Explained](https://playdreamz.com/cyberpunk-tcg-rarity-guide/): Every Cyberpunk TCG rarity symbol explained, from Common to Iconic and Nova Rare: where to find it, cards per rarity in Welcome to Night City, official pull rates, prices and Beta vs Retail.
- [Are My Pokémon Cards Worth Money? How to Check Rarity, Print, Condition & Price](https://playdreamz.com/are-my-pokemon-cards-worth-money/): How to tell if your Pokémon cards are worth money: spot 1st Edition and Shadowless prints, read rarity symbols and card numbers, judge condition and check real sold prices.
- [How to Store Pokémon Cards: Sleeves, Binders, Humidity & Long-Term Care](https://playdreamz.com/how-to-store-pokemon-cards/): How to store Pokémon cards so they keep their value: penny sleeves, toploaders and binders, the right humidity and temperature, where to keep them at home, and graded and sealed product.
- [How to Spot Fake Pokémon Booster Packs: Resealed, Weighed & Counterfeit](https://playdreamz.com/how-to-spot-fake-pokemon-booster-packs/): How to tell counterfeit, resealed and weighed Pokémon booster packs from real ones: wrapper and print checks, crimps and seams, shrink wrap on boxes and ETBs, and where to buy safely.
- [Top 10 Most Valuable Pikachu Cards in 2026](https://playdreamz.com/top-value-pikachu-cards/): Discover the top 10 most valuable Pikachu cards in 2026 — from the $16.5M Pikachu Illustrator to rare Japanese promos. Real PSA 10 prices and collector tips.
- [Pokémon Card Investing Guide: Is It Still Worth It in 2026?](https://playdreamz.com/pokemon-card-investing-guide/): Is it too late to invest in Pokémon cards? Our 2026 guide breaks down real costs, risks, and safe strategies for beginners looking to start their collection.
- [Is Grading Pokémon Cards Worth It in 2026: The Profit vs. Loss Breakdown](https://playdreamz.com/is-grading-pokemon-cards-worth-it/): Is grading Pokémon cards worth it in 2026? Compare PSA vs. BGS costs, analyze real ROI data, and use our exact formula to decide if you will profit or lose money.
- [How to Tell If a Pokémon Card Is Fake: 5 Real vs Fake Tests](https://playdreamz.com/fake-pokemon-cards-guide/): Learn how to identify fake Pokémon cards with 5 simple tests. Check texture, card back colors, and the light test. Protect your collection from counterfeits today.
- [Pokémon TCG Rarity Guide: Card Rarity Symbols & Chart Explained](https://playdreamz.com/pokemon-tcg-rarity-guide/): Is your card worth $5 or $500? Master the Pokémon TCG rarity guide and chart. Learn to identify Special Illustration Rares, check texture and see what each rarity is really worth.
